name: Lauryn Widget Suite for Elementor
author: lauryn77

sections.description:
Lauryn Widget Suite for Elementor adds focused, customizable widgets designed to extend Elementor with practical layouts for real websites.

View the Live Demo

Stacking Cards

Create interactive card stacks with a swipe-style experience and responsive controls.

  • Build cards manually with Elementor’s Repeater.
  • Add an image, title, subtitle, button text and URL to each card.
  • Use Latest Posts as an automatic source, even without Elementor Pro.
  • Display post featured images, titles, excerpts and permalinks automatically.
  • Filter Latest Posts by category and control order, excerpt length and button text.
  • Customize card size, offsets, rotation and swipe threshold.
  • Control image size, position and repeat behavior.
  • Style card backgrounds, typography, buttons and hover states.
  • Responsive geometry is optimized to preserve the visible card stack without causing horizontal page overflow.

Service Card

Build flexible cards for services, treatments, consultations, packages, pricing and other structured content.

  • Optional image and ribbon.
  • Image tags and feature lists.
  • Subtitle, title and WYSIWYG description.
  • Duration, price and price suffix fields.
  • Optional call-to-action button.
  • Responsive inline or stacked feature layouts.
  • Equal Height and Footer Alignment controls.
  • Comprehensive styling controls for each section of the card.
  • Elementor Dynamic Tags support for Service Card content fields.
  • Dynamic list sources compatible with Post Terms, ACF and other text-based dynamic sources.

The widgets are available inside the Lauryn Widgets category in the Elementor editor.

See examples and try the widgets on the Live Demo

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Elementor Ltd.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor.
  2. Upload and activate Lauryn Widget Suite for Elementor.
  3. Edit a page with Elementor.
  4. Find the “Lauryn Widgets” category in the Elementor panel.
  5. Drag Stacking Cards or Service Card into your page and customize it.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. The plugin works with Elementor, and the Stacking Cards Latest Posts source does not require Elementor Pro.

Where can I see the widgets in action?

Visit the Lauryn Widget Suite Live Demo to see examples of the available widgets.

Can I use dynamic content in the Service Card?

Yes. Service Card supports Elementor Dynamic Tags for its content fields. Dynamic list sources can also work with Post Terms, ACF and other text-based dynamic sources.

Can Stacking Cards display WordPress posts automatically?

Yes. Select Latest Posts as the source and configure the number of posts, category, ordering, excerpt length and button text.
